short_description: All-in-one EHR and practice management for mental health practices with scheduling, billing, telehealth, and documentation.
long_description: PracticeQ (formerly Jane App in some contexts) is a comprehensive practice management and EHR platform designed for healthcare practices including mental health, physical therapy, and wellness providers. For mental health practices, PracticeQ offers integrated scheduling with online booking, customizable clinical documentation, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, billing and insurance claims processing, and a patient portal. The platform is known for its user-friendly interface and ability to handle the complete practice workflow from intake to payment. PracticeQ supports both solo practitioners and group practices with role-based permissions and multi-location support.

pricing.notes: Pricing varies by practice size and features. Free trial available.

privacy.notes: HIPAA-compliant with BAA available. Built for healthcare practice data security.

faqs.q: What is PracticeQ and what features does it include?
faqs.a: PracticeQ is an all-in-one practice management and EHR platform. It includes online scheduling, clinical documentation, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, billing with insurance claims, a patient portal, and intake forms. It's designed for healthcare practices including mental health.

faqs.q: How does PracticeQ compare to SimplePractice for therapists?
faqs.a: Both are popular mental health EHRs. PracticeQ tends to offer more customization and is popular with multi-disciplinary practices. SimplePractice is known for ease of use and mental health-specific features. Pricing and specific feature needs should guide the choice.

faqs.q: Is PracticeQ HIPAA compliant for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, PracticeQ is HIPAA-compliant and provides a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). The platform is designed with healthcare data security in mind, including encrypted telehealth and secure patient portals.

faqs.q: Can PracticeQ handle insurance billing for therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, PracticeQ includes billing features with insurance claims submission. It supports mental health CPT codes, superbills, and integrates with clearinghouses for electronic claims. Some users also use it for patient invoicing and payment processing.
